description: This file defines a PHP class 'File' within the namespace 'Opencart\System\Library\Session'. The class manages session data stored in files, providing methods to read, write, destroy, and garbage collect session files. It is part of the OpenCart e-commerce platform's session management system.

classes.name: File
classes.description: A class responsible for session management via file storage, including reading, writing, deleting, and garbage collection of session files.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the session handler with a registry object to access configuration settings.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads session data from a file based on session ID, returning the session data as an array.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes session data to a file associated with the session ID, encoding it as JSON.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Deletes the session file corresponding to the given session ID.

methods.name: gc
methods.description: Performs garbage collection by deleting session files older than the expiration time based on configuration.
